## An idempotent in a ring generated by representation matrices

[Theorem ALG.0982](https://andrewodesky.com/rh/lean/GlobalTheory.SpanIdem.exists_idem/)

Let $\ell$ be prime, $A$ a commutative $\mathbb Z_\ell$-algebra finite as a $\mathbb Z_\ell$-module, $X$ a finite set, and $\Gamma$ a group. Fix $n\ge0$, representations $\rho_x:\Gamma\to\operatorname{GL}_n(A)$, and an $A$-subalgebra $T\subseteq A^X$. Define $$\mathcal R=\left\{\sum_{i=1}^m f_i\rho(g_i):m\ge0,\ f_i\in T,\ g_i\in\Gamma\right\}\subseteq\prod_{x\in X}M_n(A),$$ where multiplication by $f_i$ and all matrix operations are pointwise. Let $b\in\mathcal R$ and $x_0\in X$ satisfy $b(x_0)^2=b(x_0)$. There is $E\in\mathcal R$ such that $$E^2=E,\qquad E(x_0)=b(x_0),$$ and, for every $y\in\prod_{x\in X}M_n(A)$, $$yb=0\Longrightarrow yE=0,\qquad by=0\Longrightarrow Ey=0.$$

## Orthogonal idempotents in a finite family of representation algebras

[Theorem ALG.1024](https://andrewodesky.com/rh/lean/GlobalTheory.SpanIdem.exists_orthogonal_idempotents/)

Let $\ell$ be prime, $A$ a commutative integral domain finite as a $\mathbb Z_\ell$-module, and $K=\operatorname{Frac}(A)$. Let $X$ be a finite set, $\Gamma$ a group, $T\subseteq A^X$ an $A$-subalgebra, and choose representations $\sigma_x:\Gamma\to\operatorname{GL}_n(A)$, $\rho:\Gamma\to\operatorname{GL}_r(A)$, characters $\chi_j:\Gamma\to A^\times$ for $j\ge0$, and $\pi\in X$.

Assume $r\ge2$, the $A$-linear span of $\rho(\Gamma)$ is $M_r(A)$, and an isomorphism $e:K^n\simeq K^r\oplus K^t$ identifies $\sigma_\pi$ with $$\rho\oplus\chi_1\oplus\cdots\oplus\chi_t.$$ There exist matrix families $e_B,e_1\in\prod_{x\in X}M_n(A)$ belonging to the algebra described below, such that $$e_B^2=e_B,\quad e_1^2=e_1,\quad e_Be_1=e_1e_B=0.$$ At $x=\pi$, in the coordinates $e$, they act as $$e_B(u,v)=(0,v),\qquad e_1(u,v)=(\epsilon u,0),$$ where $\epsilon\in M_r(K)$ has rank one.
